milestone: Inline anonymous functions and lexical captures for sequential native numeric map
implementation: Handwritten parser LambdaExpr; contextual one-element callback parameter and optional numeric result annotation. Lexical lookup lifts only referenced completed CPU bindings into private callback parameters, including through nested closures. ArrayMap records capture operands; continuation extraction imports and remaps the complete callback/helper/capture graph. MLIR evaluates captures once and supplies them to ordered callback calls. Existing checked invocation ABI, ownership runtime, scheduler and numeric engines are unchanged.

contract.syntax: map(values, fn(value): value + offset) equals values -> map(fn(value): value + offset). Named callbacks remain supported.
contract.inference: Input array establishes parameter type unless explicitly annotated. Result is inferred or explicitly annotated. Numeric conversions are explicit. Untyped empty input needs callback parameter annotation.
contract.captures: Referenced lexical CPU numeric scalars, numeric arrays/tensors and scalar Bool only. Parameter shadowing, repeated reads deduplicated, and nested grandparent captures supported. Pending task handles, fallible values and device values rejected.
contract.evaluation: Synchronous ordered execution; captures established once, no callback for empty input, unchanged input and output length. One explicit element argument; no implicit parallel work.
contract.workers: Direct spawn map and mapping in ordinary worker helpers use immutable captured values. Nested closures/helper definitions, cached awaits, returned arrays, recovery and source faults use existing protocols.
contract.scope: Anonymous expression callbacks in map context only. No first-class function variables/aliases, escaped closures, anonymous block bodies, GPU map or distributed execution.

qualification.parser_test_repair: The initial 69-test run passed all 67 implementation/runtime checks. Two parser suites expected anonymous functions to remain unsupported. Updated that obsolete rejection test, added anonymous AST/span/annotation and malformed-syntax checks, then both parser suites passed on targeted rerun. No compiler implementation changed after the initial qualification run.
qualification.scope: Focused frontend, map/closure, arrays, tensor inference, source/tasks/recovery, control-flow, storage and selected Metal regressions; not the full suite.
coverage: 36 anonymous numeric conversion type pairs checked, planned and lowered alongside all 36 named-map pairs.
Inferred and annotated parameters/results, typed empty arrays, lexical captures, parameter shadowing, repeated capture deduplication, nested grandparent captures and unused pending tasks.
Reject arity/type errors, standalone function values, unresolved names, pending tasks/fallible captures, transitively resumable callbacks and malformed capture IDs/counts/types.
Six raw identity closures with Bool capture: boundary/random raw bits, eight ARM FP states, strided borrowed inputs, allocation-failure sweeps and retained results after invocation settlement.

Six numeric worker families with scalar/Bool/tensor/array captures, nested closures, ordinary helper graph import, direct spawn map, empty callbacks, cached awaits and original-source Arithmetic recovery.
1/2/4-worker success, cancellation, deadlines, admission, core allocation failure positions 1-8 and generated invocation allocation positions 1-8 with two workers.
Debug, optimized, ASan/UBSan and separate ThreadSanitizer execution. Sanitized frontend includes all new rejection/capture tests.
Existing named-map raw identity/conversion/order/recovery suites and prior array/source/storage/selected Metal regressions rerun.

remaining_gates: Anonymous block bodies and broader callback/collection value types
Explicit parallel-per-element map and expected-error callbacks
Native distributed execution requires design discussion
